summary: Theme toggle feature for tactical board tested successfully. All 14 test cases passed. Light/dark theme switching works correctly with proper CSS variable changes, localStorage persistence, icon toggling, field re-rendering, 3D mode support, and sport switching persistence.

issues: Arrow default color uses ST.lineColor (#1e293b) instead of theme-based default. This is by design - lineColor is a user preference that persists across theme changes. The theme-based default (#94a3b8 dark / #1e293b light) only applies when lineColor is not set.

critical_code_review_comments: Theme implementation is well-structured with CSS variables in :root and html.dark selectors
toggleTheme() correctly toggles 'dark' class, updates ST.theme, saves to localStorage, and re-renders field
loadTheme() properly restores theme from localStorage on page load
getFieldColors() returns theme-appropriate colors for field rendering
Arrow marker stroke adapts to theme: rgba(255,255,255,0.7) in dark, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) in light
3D field rendering uses getFieldColors() for surface3d, front3d, right3d colors
